response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS diff_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC

assumptions.assumption: Byte rate is computed per track as Bytes/Milliseconds using real (non-integer) division, then averaged per media type name; tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded.
Milliseconds is NOT NULL in the schema; zero-millisecond tracks are assumed not to exist (otherwise division by zero could occur).
Media types sharing the same name are grouped together as one, per the request's 'grouped by name'; the overall average is over these name groups.
Media types with no qualifying tracks do not appear and are not counted in the overall average.
